verdict.rationale: First-party AMD docs give the MI325X's capacity: 256 GiB VRAM in the ROCm GPU specs table and 256GB of HBM memory per accelerator in the system acceptance guide, which also names the memory type as HBM3. Nothing in the evidence gives the memory bus width or bandwidth, so only half of the requested spec set is shown. Missing for 10: memory bus width, memory bandwidth figure, a single full memory-spec table for this part.
